title.narrative: Enhanced sustainable and gender-sensitive agricultural water management and irrigation systems for smallholder farmers in selected districts of the Lower Kafue sub-catchment

description.narrative: The Action enhances climate smart water resources management (WRM) and efficient agricultural water use for smallholders in the Lower Kafue Sub-catchment, applying a gender sensitive approach. It contributes to increased productivity of smallholders in the Lower Kafue Sub-catchment and more sustainable use and better management of water resources by delivering three key outputs:1.Smallholders increasingly apply new technical options for efficient use of water resources2.Capacities of public and private extension service providers to train smallholder farmers on efficient water use, harvesting and irrigation are strengthened3.Capacities of integrated water resource management structures at local and Lower Kafue Sub-catchment level are improved, with a specific focus on female water users
